method: Direct visual inspection of all seven front PNGs against public/data/monsters.json art_brief. Names alone are not design agreement.

records.name: Mosskin
records.findings: One leafy stalk rather than two twig antennae; only two feet clearly visible. Four-legged seed anatomy needs a new reference.

records.name: Sporeling
records.findings: Bright red cap and boot-like feet rather than cream/rust cap and stubby root feet. Revise palette and foot anatomy.

records.name: Ambermite
records.findings: Opaque crystal-armored shell, no visible glowing internal core; six legs not clearly readable. Needs translucent amber shell.

records.name: Lunari
records.findings: Blue/pink fox-like silhouette with oversized ears; no readable gliding membrane or banded tail, wrong silver-green palette.

records.name: Reedstalker
records.findings: Bird anatomy contradicts woven reed stalk-creature with opening seed-pod head.

records.name: Rotroot
records.findings: Upright red-accented tree creature lacks sickly teal sap core and low crawling root-knot anatomy.

records.name: Barkwarden
records.findings: Organic tree guardian lacks copper joints and single cracked lens eye; leafy seams instead of moss.
